question: The long jumper ______________ won Silver in the U-20 World Athletics Championships in August 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Shaili Singh__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shaili Singh i**s an Indian athlete who competes in long jump events.
 
• She is the junior Indian national long jump champion in age group category.
 
• Ranks among the world's top 20 long jumpers in the Under-18 category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf799b250a7f421727af9ee1ad92e9b93c4c0c51735b257d05f2ed1d765f8dfa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maliakhal Anthony Prajusha** is an Indian track and field athlete from Kerala who competes in the long jump and triple jump
 
• **Nayana James **is an Indian athlete competing in the long jump event. She gained a bronze medal at the 2017 Asian Athletics Champions
 
• **Reeth Abraham** is an athlete from Bengaluru, India and former Asian medalist in the long jump.
